g.text: The badge supply and the coin cell sit on separate switch contacts and are never connected to each other.

g.desc: The badge supply and the coin cell sit on separate switch contacts and are never connected to each other.

g.text: SAO++ power select: the switch common feeds the board. Position 1 = badge 3.3 V, position 2 = OFF (pin 2 unconnected), position 3 = coin cell (through D9).

g.desc: SAO++ power select: the switch common feeds the board. Position 1 = badge 3.3 V, position 2 = OFF (pin 2 unconnected), position 3 = coin cell (through D9).

g.text: D9 (series Schottky, docs/standard.md section 3) is required: the ATtiny's PB4 is wired to SAO GPIO2, so the badge could push current into the cell through it.

g.desc: D9 (series Schottky, docs/standard.md section 3) is required: the ATtiny's PB4 is wired to SAO GPIO2, so the badge could push current into the cell through it.

g.text: R9 (330 ohm) is the series resistor the SAO spec asks for on a GPIO the add-on may drive; the maker's 2024 board wired PB4 straight to the header.

g.desc: R9 (330 ohm) is the series resistor the SAO spec asks for on a GPIO the add-on may drive; the maker's 2024 board wired PB4 straight to the header.

g.text: D1..D8 are on the FRONT (art side) in the maker's scanner positions; resistors 1.3k (maker: 1k): about 0.9 mA per LED at 3.0 V, 1.15 mA at 3.3 V.

g.desc: D1..D8 are on the FRONT (art side) in the maker's scanner positions; resistors 1.3k (maker: 1k): about 0.9 mA per LED at 3.0 V, 1.15 mA at 3.3 V.

g.text: JP1: the maker's six AVR ISP pads (bare copper). SW2: the maker's push button on PB4.

g.desc: JP1: the maker's six AVR ISP pads (bare copper). SW2: the maker's push button on PB4.

g.text: Maker's circuit (davedarko, KiCad 8 2024): ATtiny85 drives 8 red LEDs from 4 pins; each pin lights one LED to GND when HIGH and one LED from VLOAD when LOW.

g.desc: Maker's circuit (davedarko, KiCad 8 2024): ATtiny85 drives 8 red LEDs from 4 pins; each pin lights one LED to GND when HIGH and one LED from VLOAD when LOW.
